notes: Merged old k76–k79 (washing powder, laundry liquid, laundry capsules, laundry sheets) into one tier kind 'Laundry detergent' with form and specialist-wash types; old k88 'Fabric waterproofing spray' became 'Fabric waterproofing and technical wash' with wash-in/spray-on/technical/down types. Nothing dropped. Models are limited to independent test winners (Consumer Reports best-and-worst page and sheets review; Which? test list) plus market-leading ranges named in the brief. Arm & Hammer and All appear only as test-winner ranges without register entries because no brand page was retrieved for them. Method's Wikipedia URL redirects to the Ecover article, which covers Method's 2012 acquisition. Which? Best Buy names are paywalled, so Which? items are listed as tested, not as winners. Seventh Generation sheets are attested by the Seventh Generation Wikipedia page listing laundry detergent as a product line; no separate product page was fetched. No craft traditions apply to this shelf. Wiki/wikidata tools were unavailable (lock error), so all sources were retrieved via web_fetch.
